# Cases run by upstream with the INSECURE security profile and javascript
# links allowed (system properties, see testdata/javagen/SvgGolden.java);
# the Go side sets them with "opt insecure" and "opt allowjs".

case insecure-imagesvg
opt insecure
opt allowjs
translate 5 6
imagesvg 1 <svg\sxmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"\swidth="20"\sheight="10"><g><rect\swidth="20"\sheight="10"\sfill="red"/></g></svg>
translate 30 0
imagesvg 2 <svg\sxmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"\sviewBox="0\s0\s12.5\s8"><rect\swidth="5"\sheight="5"/></svg>
translate 30 0
imagesvg 1 <svg\sxmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"\swidth="20"\sheight="10"><g><rect\swidth="20"\sheight="10"\sfill="red"/></g></svg>
push
hidden
imagesvg 1 <svg\sxmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"\swidth="200"\sheight="100"><g/></svg>
pop
write

case insecure-scaled
opt insecure
opt allowjs
opt scale 2
imagesvg 1.5 <svg\sxmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"\swidth="20"\sheight="10"><g\sid="a"><rect\swidth="20"\sheight="10"/></g></svg>
write

case insecure-javascript-links
opt insecure
opt allowjs
url javascript:alert(1)
color #181818
rect 4 4
endurl
url JaVa\sScRiPt:alert(2) tip
rect 4 4
endurl
write
